verdict.rationale: ScrapingBee documents several ways to control when content comes back. The headless browser can wait for a CSS/XPath selector before returning HTML. JS scenarios can run interactions and explicit `wait` steps before return. Blocking ads and resources trades completeness for speed. Missing for 10: documentation of a standalone wait/timeout or network-idle parameter, any explicit latency figures for the HTML API, and independent or hands-on corroboration that these controls behave as described.
